title: Clique containment property
statement: Let $v$ and $k$ be nonnegative integers, and let $G$ be a graph on the vertex set $\{0,1,\ldots,v-1\}$, encoded by assigning a Boolean value to each two-element vertex set. The clique-containment property of $G$ is the Boolean value that is true exactly when $G$ contains a clique of size $k$.
caveat: The supplied snippet does not include the definition of adjacency, so the exact meaning of an encoded edge's Boolean value is unavailable.
